Spatial audio is experimental and the author could not hear a difference. Some vivo models (TWS Air 3 Pro) only; commands come from community reverse engineering and may break after firmware updates.

⚠️ Toggling may cause sudden volume changes or loud noise. Take the earbuds out, set volume to minimum, confirm it is safe, then wear them.

May take a few seconds to apply. Some vivo models (TWS Air 3 Pro) only. Take the earbuds out and lower the volume while testing; do not switch repeatedly.

This is an unofficial, unauthorized third-party research tool that controls the earbuds by reverse-engineered private protocol. It collects and uploads no data.

⚠️ Safety: private commands are not certified by the vendor. They may cause sudden loud noise, feedback or volume jumps and damage your hearing. Before connecting a new model, the first use after a firmware update, or before enabling any experimental feature under "Developer", take the earbuds out (do not wear them), set volume to minimum, and only put them on after confirming it is safe. Do not use while driving, cycling or operating machinery.

Hearing damage is irreversible. Please be careful. You use this app entirely at your own risk.
